name: structured_light_interface

pixel.crop: separate_from_roi; preserve original coordinates using explicit crop origin

centroid.zero_weight: invalid; centroid_fixed helper raises ValueError; wire invalid centers preserved
centroid.multiple_candidates: invalid in new candidate datapath; do not interpret inter-segment weighted center as surface point
centroid.quality: 8-bit peak-related legacy indicator, not confidence probability
centroid.diagnostics: S0, S1, candidate_count absent in old wire format; retain null, add only versioned sidecar records
centroid.validity: decode valid bit verbatim; do not infer validity from flags or missing diagnostics

profiles.name: SLP1
profiles.angle_semantics: opaque legacy value, unit unknown; angle_rad null

profiles.name: SLP2
profiles.timestamp_semantics: system counter latched when capture request accepted; NOT exposure or camera SOF timestamp

wire.reserved_point_bits: reject nonzero; known canonical legacy fixtures have zero reserved bits
wire.header_error_flags: preserve uint32 opaque word; current hardware supplies camera EOF low16
wire.invalid_rows: preserve, including nonzero center and flags
wire.frame_id: null if not provided independently; never substitute profile_id
wire.diagnostic_sidecar: schema/version explicit, no changes to SLP2 packet

registers.name: CONTROL
registers.notes: Read zero. START/HOME rejected while busy; STOP and CLEAR command pulses remain permitted. CLEAR only flushes capture in IDLE/DONE/ERROR with no in-flight transaction; not an unconditional abort/reset.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.notes: Read-only hardware status.

registers.name: THRESHOLD
registers.notes: Configuration write rejected while busy; WSTRB lane merge; reset value is legacy/offline default, not a physical recommendation.

registers.name: ROI_START
registers.notes: Raw frame coordinates, packed y0<<16 | x0.

registers.name: ROI_END
registers.notes: Exclusive raw frame coordinates; crop has separate offsets.

registers.name: MIN_WIDTH
registers.notes: Configuration write rejected while busy; WSTRB lane merge; reset value is legacy/offline default, not a physical recommendation.

registers.name: ERROR_FLAGS
registers.notes: Sticky register diagnostics; packet error_flags contains camera EOF low16 only, so semantics differ.

registers.name: CURRENT_ANGLE
registers.notes: Unsigned Q16.16 radians; command-step estimate, not encoder-certified mechanical angle.

registers.name: TIMESTAMP_LOW
registers.notes: Reading LOW latches 64-bit snapshot. Read HIGH next.

registers.name: TIMESTAMP_HIGH
registers.notes: Read latched snapshot after LOW; no independently fresh high word.

registers.name: PROFILE_ID
registers.notes: Read-only hardware status.

registers.name: IRQ_STATUS
registers.notes: Write-one-to-clear, same-cycle event wins over clear.

registers.name: IRQ_ENABLE
registers.notes: Configuration write rejected while busy; WSTRB lane merge; reset value is legacy/offline default, not a physical recommendation.

registers.name: MECH_STEPS_LOW
registers.notes: Read LOW to latch mechanical_step_counter snapshot, then HIGH.

registers.name: MECH_STEPS_HIGH
registers.notes: High half of snapshot captured by LOW read.

registers.name: FIFO_LEVEL
registers.notes: Read-only hardware status.

registers.name: VERSION
registers.notes: Register map version only; separate from profile format version.

scope: P0 contract and host parsing only; no MMIO, DMA, camera, motor, RTL implementation or board activation.
